_provenance.normalization: r_k = |m_hat-m_bar|_k / delta_k ; delta_k the pre-registered decision threshold from blind_verdicts.json (z=1.96, incl 2% mitigation-bias term). r_k>1 == moment k fires (reproduces moment_fire 300/300).
_provenance.separating_definition: mode==ac (spurious-feature, preserves total weight & support by construction) AND pre-registered reject AND r0<=1 (total-weight sum rule blind) AND (r1>1 or r2>1) (an off-diagonal moment fires).
